site.title: Midwest Vitals
site.subtitle: The U.S., Illinois and Wisconsin economies, plus their banks and credit unions, on one page. Public data, updated automatically.

scorecard.title: Community bank deposit growth
scorecard.units: % y/y, same banks, under $10B a year earlier

charts.title: Real GDP growth
charts.note: State GDP is published by BEA about one quarter after the national estimate.

charts.title: State coincident index
charts.note: Philadelphia Fed coincident indexes combine payrolls, hours, unemployment and wages into a monthly read on state activity.

charts.title: Personal income
charts.note: U.S. is monthly; states are quarterly (BEA).

charts.title: Initial jobless claims
charts.note: Indexed so states and the nation share one scale. U.S. claims are seasonally adjusted; state claims are not, so each state week is compared with the same week of 2019.

charts.title: Average hourly earnings, private
charts.note: State series are not seasonally adjusted; y/y comparison handles that.

charts.title: Consumer prices
charts.note: BLS does not publish state CPI. Chicago metro covers most of Illinois' population; the Midwest regional index is the closest available proxy for Wisconsin.

charts.title: Core consumer prices (ex food and energy)
Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
Federal debt held by the public

sections.title: Banks (FDIC-insured)
sections.intro: Illinois figures are by headquarters state, so a handful of very large Chicago-chartered banks would dominate any all-bank aggregate. Ratios below are medians across banks; growth rates use the community bank cohort (under $10 billion).

charts.title: Number of banks headquartered in state
charts.note: U.S. omitted so the state lines stay readable.

charts.title: Community bank deposit growth
charts.units: % y/y, same banks, under $10B a year earlier
charts.note: Compares the same banks at both dates, so banks crossing $10B, merging away or closing do not distort growth. Banks whose assets grew more than 30% in the year are left out as likely acquirers.

charts.title: Community bank loan growth
charts.units: % y/y, same banks, under $10B a year earlier

charts.title: Cash and securities share of assets

sections.title: Credit unions (NCUA-insured)
sections.intro: Federally insured credit unions by state of headquarters. Growth rates are aggregates; ratios are medians across credit unions.
